profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I am a Software Engineer and founder of EasyMealPlanner LLC and StevenCodeCraft. My product, FitFuelPlanner, is a web and mobile app that helps users get fit by generating a personalized workout and meal plan. It offers over 100 recipes with the calories and macronutrients measured.

Company Website: https://fitfuelplanner.com

iOS App: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/fitfuel-workout-meal-planner/id6468933781

At StevenCodeCraft.com, I help aspiring software developers build web and mobile apps by sharing my beginner-friendly courses.

Previously I worked as a Jr.  Software Engineer at Toshiba America Business Solutions located in Lake Forest, California.

At Cal State Long Beach and through my internships, I learned the skills of working on a team following the Scrum/agile methodology, collaborating to meet deadlines, and working to deliver well-tested code. 

As a self-motivated developer, I seek to continually grow my skill-set through side projects and courses.

A career in technology excites me as it allows a lifetime of growth, and the ability to impact others through building applications at scale.

Front-end Skills:
* JavaScript
* TypeScript
* HTML5
* CSS3
* React
* Expo React Native
* Angular
* Next.js
* Redux

Back-end Skills: 
* C#, ASP.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, Entity Framework Core, LINQ
* Java, Spring Boot, Spring Data JPA, Spring Boot Security, JUnit, Maven
* Node.js, Express.js
* MySQL, Postgres

DevOps Skills: Docker, Docker-Compose

Cloud Computing Skills:
AWS: S3, EC2, Elastic Beanstalk, RDS, CloudFront, Route53

Other Skills: Git, Agile, Scrum

Portfolio Website: https://stevencodecraft.com/about

positions.title: Full-Stack Software Developer (Founder)
positions.description:
An all-in-one web and mobile app designed for discovering recipes, workout plans, meal plans, streamlining grocery shopping, and seamlessly tracking your calories and macronutrients.

https://fitfuelplanner.com

- Developed FitFuelPlanner, a comprehensive web app, iOS, Android, and API designed to help users achieve their fitness and nutrition goals.
- Implemented advanced features, including pagination, sorting, and filtering, for both recipes and exercises, enhancing user experience and usability.
- Developed intricate workout plans using SQL, demonstrating strong database design skills and domain expertise in fitness and nutrition.
- Crafted and implemented the web client using Next.js and Redux, providing a seamless and responsive user interface for the web version of the application.
- Created the mobile app using Expo React Native, delivering a native-like experience for both iOS and Android users.
positions.insights: Skills: React Native · React.js · Next.js · TypeScript · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · .NET Core

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Improved the performance of sorting, selection, and rendering of a UI table by implementing pagination.
- Utilized the Object-Oriented principles of inheritance and interfaces to implement 14 customized Angular Material UI tables with reusable TypeScript classes.
- Implemented responsive user-interface components in HTML, SCSS, and TypeScript to meet the design spec and display the text localized based on a user's language.
- Developed and designed a front-end security setting modal for users to configure device settings and post to an API.
- Improved front-end code coverage by 21% by adding unit tests in TypeScript, Jasmine, and Karma.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML5 · TypeScript · Angular · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS)

positions.title: Software Developer Intern
positions.description:
- Created a Page Title feature with NgRx (Redux) state management and ASP.NET Core for displaying on-premise environment configuration
- Updated dialog components to enable popup windows to have ability to maximize and resize for improved UI/UX
- Developed components to have responsive SCSS styles to match the design specification by UI/UX designers
- Implemented unit test for Angular components, reducers, and selectors in Jasmine and Karma to ensure code quality

positions.title: QA Analyst Intern
positions.description:
- Implemented the Python front-end automation for the mobile app, OSHI, and performed manual regression tests for quality assurance 
- Improved the speed for the user registration automation by 4% by implementing methods to support resource IDs
- Refactored the automation codebase to eliminate implicitly waiting in Appium and implemented front-end test for iOS and Android mobile applications

positions.title: Community Service Leader
positions.description:
- Worked with senior citizens at the Gus Velasco Neighborhood Center and help inform and register them for city events
- Performed setup and takedown for city events as well as work at information booths regarding upcoming events and city resources that residents could utilize

positions.title: Mathematics Tutor
positions.description:
- Created a personalized learning curriculum for each student in the areas of Algebra, Trigonometry, and Precalculus
- Tutored students one-on-one to help complete their homework, take personalized notes, and help prepare for upcoming exams
- Communicated with each student's teachers through email to help communicate their progress, get access to required textbooks and resources, as well as receive the dates for their upcoming exams

projects.title: BugTracker Web App (React, C#, ASP.NET Core, and SQL)
projects.description: Display and keep progress for reported bugs for an application. Technology used includes C#, ASP.NET Core, Entity Framework, PostgreSQL, React, Redux, and Styled Components.

projects.title: Bucket List Social Network App (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js)
projects.description: Bucket List is a social network that connects people who share similar bucket list items. The project is a web application built with MongoDB, Express.js, React, and Node.js (MERN Stack). Consisting of two parts, the front end in React and a RESTful API built with Express.js and the Node.js runtime environment. Features of the site include a chat feature utilizing Socket.io to enable real time updates as well as an activity feed with recent post. I have also updating the project to begin to use Redux for state management for the front end.
